intro: Santiago rewards visitors with a walkable historic core, world-class museums and easy escapes to the Andes and wine valleys. Pick how long you have and what you enjoy most.
tour_note: Check the tour page for which entry tickets are included.

notes: Metro: 7 lines, 136 stations; trains run roughly 06:00–23:00.
Pay metro and buses only with a bip! card; card costs about CLP 1,550 plus minimum CLP 1,000 recharge.
Fares run about CLP 640–800 by time of day; transfers within two hours are usually free.
Buses run around the clock on main lines; Red line 555 links Pajaritos metro to the airport.
Official taxis are black and yellow; Uber operates but is not officially licensed.
Bikes are popular on a growing lane network; no ferry service in the city.

lamoneda.name: La Moneda Palace
lamoneda.price_text: Free to view from Plaza de la Constitución · interior visits by guided tour only, book ahead
lamoneda.hours: Exterior always visible · guided tours on weekday mornings, check on the day
lamoneda.tip: Come for the changing of the guard on alternate mornings and watch from the plaza, not the fence.

plazaarmas.name: Plaza de Armas of Santiago
plazaarmas.tip: Sit on a bench and people-watch; keep bags in front of you and phones out of sight.

cerrosan.name: Sanctuary of the Immaculate Conception
cerrosan.price_text: Free entry · funicular and cable car cost extra
cerrosan.hours: Grounds roughly 10:00–19:00, shorter in winter · check on the day
cerrosan.tip: Walk up or take the funicular, then stay for the city lights at dusk.

skycostanera.name: Sky Costanera
skycostanera.price_text: ≈ CLP 18,000–22,000 adult · check current price online
skycostanera.hours: Daily, roughly 10:00–21:00 · last entry before closing
skycostanera.tip: Go on a clear day about an hour before sunset for both daylight and night views.

precolombino.name: Museo Chileno de Arte Precolombino
precolombino.tip: Small but excellent; allow two hours and take the free guided intro if offered.

catedral.name: Metropolitan Cathedral of Santiago
catedral.tip: Step inside for the quiet; dress modestly and don't photograph during services.

santalucia.name: Santa Lucía Hill
santalucia.hours: Daily, roughly 09:00–19:00 · check on the day
santalucia.tip: Climb the terraces for a free city view; go in daylight and keep to the main paths.

bahai.name: Baha'i Temple of South America
bahai.hours: Daily, roughly 09:00–18:00 · check on the day
bahai.tip: Far from the centre; combine with a taxi or tour and go for the quiet gardens and mountain backdrop.

estadionacional.name: Estadio Nacional Julio Martínez Prádanos
estadionacional.price_text: Tour price varies · match tickets priced separately
estadionacional.hours: Tours on selected days · check on the day
estadionacional.tip: Only worth a stop for football fans or history buffs; check tour times before you go.

fantasilandia.name: Fantasilandia
fantasilandia.price_text: Entry ticket price varies by day · check online
fantasilandia.hours: Seasonal · usually weekends and holidays, check on the day
fantasilandia.tip: A family day out; buy tickets online and go early to beat queues.

gam.name: Gabriela Mistral Cultural Center (GAM)
gam.price_text: Free to enter · some events ticketed
gam.tip: Check the free exhibition and event board; the café is a good rest stop.

lachascona.name: La Chascona
lachascona.tip: Pablo Neruda's house; book a time slot and take the audio guide.

teatromunicipal.name: Teatro Municipal
teatromunicipal.price_text: Ticket price varies by performance · check programme
teatromunicipal.hours: Box office and performances · check on the day
teatromunicipal.tip: Book online for opera or ballet; cheap seats still give a grand hall view.

mercadocentral.name: Mercado Central
mercadocentral.price_text: Meal prices vary · check menus before ordering
mercadocentral.hours: Daily, roughly 09:00–17:00 · check on the day
mercadocentral.tip: Go for a seafood lunch; agree the price before you order and skip pushy touts.

lastarria.name: Barrio Lastarria walk
lastarria.price_text: Free to walk · cafés and shops extra
lastarria.hours: Always open · liveliest afternoons and evenings
lastarria.tip: Wander the streets between the park and the river for cafés, bookshops and street art.

bellavista.name: Bellavista neighbourhood walk
bellavista.price_text: Free to walk · bars and food extra
bellavista.tip: Colourful streets below San Cristóbal; go in daylight, then stay for dinner.

empanada.name: Empanada de Pino
empanada.hours: Bakery hours vary · most open daily
empanada.tip: The classic Chilean baked empanada with beef, onion, egg and olive; eat it warm from a local bakery.

cerrosanfunicular.name: San Cristóbal funicular and cable car ride
cerrosanfunicular.price_text: Ticket price varies · check at the station
cerrosanfunicular.tip: Ride up and walk down through the park; check the cable car is running before you buy.

vinacomparada.name: Vineyard day trip to Maipo Valley
vinacomparada.price_text: ≈ CLP 40,000–90,000 per person · varies by tour
vinacomparada.hours: Half or full day · book ahead
vinacomparada.tip: Book a tour with transport included; wine tasting is the point, so don't drive.

cerrosancristobal.name: Parque Metropolitano viewpoint
cerrosancristobal.price_text: Free to enter · transport up costs extra
cerrosancristobal.hours: Daily, roughly 09:00–19:00 · check on the day
cerrosancristobal.tip: The big hill above the city; bring water and a layer, it is cooler up top.

styles.label: Food

styles.label: Nature
styles.blurb: Andes views, Cerro San Cristóbal and Cajón del Maipo.

stays.why: Walk to the Plaza de Armas, La Moneda and the markets. Busiest and noisiest at night; keep valuables close.
Colourful streets below Cerro San Cristóbal, close to La Chascona and nightlife. Lively, so pick a quiet side street.
Safe, leafy and well connected by Metro Line 1. Good mix of cafés, restaurants and shops.
Modern, calm and close to the Sky Costanera and Parque Arauco. Farther from the old centre; rely on Metro or taxis.

food: Eat seafood at the Mercado Central or Vega Central: try paila marina (shellfish stew) and reineta fish. Prices vary; check the menu before ordering.
Order a completo (hot dog with avocado, tomato and mayo) or an italiano sandwich at a local fuente de soda. Cheap and filling.
Try a pastel de choclo (corn pie) and empanadas de pino. Lunch is the big meal; many places offer a fixed menú at midday.
Coffee culture is strong: order a café or a cortado. For a sweet treat, look for mote con huesillo in summer.
Wine is a highlight. Ask for Chilean Carménère or Sauvignon Blanc by the glass, and consider a day trip to a nearby vineyard.
more_time: Add a day trip to Valparaíso and Viña del Mar: buses leave often from the city, roughly 1.5–2 hours each way. Check schedules on the day.
Swap a city afternoon for Cajón del Maipo in the Andes: book a tour or arrange transport, as public options are limited.
Wine lovers can spend a half-day at a Maipo Valley vineyard. Book ahead; many tastings need a reservation.
